title: extractJSON returns inner object instead of enclosing array when wrapped in prose
property: a JSON value embedded in prose is extracted intact
actual: {a:1} (the first object; '{' is searched before '[' regardless of position)
evidence: Docstring: 'Find the first JSON object/array in text'. The array starts before the object, so it is first; an array of objects is a common agent output.

title: fmtMs rounds seconds up to 60 producing '60s' / '1m60s'
property_test: fmtMs never prints 60s or NNmSS with SS>=60
evidence: Time formats NmSS must have seconds in 00-59; Math.round(s % 60) and toFixed(0) can reach 60 without carrying.

title: relPath treats child paths whose name starts with '..' as outside the root
property: a path inside root yields a relative path
property_test: relPath of child inside root is relative
evidence: r.startsWith('..') is meant to detect parent traversal, but also matches legitimate names like '..foo' or '...'; it should check r === '..' or startsWith('..' + sep).
